decision.summary: A large, abrupt U drop at indices 600–602 (≈−15 MAD) is the clearest discontinuity, sustained through index 629, with partial rebound starting at 630. N shows a smaller delayed step up (~+3 MAD) around 605–610, but no clear return. E displays non-monotonic behavior without a definitive opposing edge. The U offset lacks full recovery within allowed context [560,670], and cross-axis responses are inconsistent with a clean temporary offset; thus all candidate intervals are marked uncertain. No confirmed temporary offset interval meets the requirement of clear onset, sustained interior, and opposing return on the same axis.

intervals.observation: U drops sharply (~−15 MAD) at indices 600–602, remains depressed through ~629; N shows delayed step up (~+3 MAD) around 605–610; E exhibits non-monotonic behavior without clear opposing return. Return in U is observed at index 630 (U rises from −22.7 to −18.1), but full recovery to pre-drop level not achieved within allowed context. Status uncertain due to incomplete return and superposed motion.

E shows a complex, non-monotonic response during 600–634 with no clear opposing edge; U rebound begins at 630 but E does not show a matching reversal. No confirmed temporary offset in E alone—coincident with U depression but shape inconsistent with isolated temporary offset. Status uncertain.
